sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Deals physical damage 2 times that penetrates any nullifying or invulnerability effects with a success value of 100. (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% elevation for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 120 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 2 when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Fire and Wind Defense from Unison Damage +500
